In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the PPy derived nanocomposites have a great potential for use in electrochemical applications.
the hybridization of ZrO2 with PPy and poly(Py co N methylpyrrolyl) derivatives results in the formation of new nanomaterials with enhanced thermal stability and electrical conductivity.
the hybridization of the ZrO nanoparticles with the polymers leads to a synergic effect on the properties of these materials.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the PPy derived polymer/Zr nanoparticles nanocomposites can be prepared via a simple one pot polymerization.
, the nanocomposites are promising materials for electrochemical applications and the PPy ZrnO2 and poly (Py co mPy)ZrO2 nanomaterials are the most promising materials.
the PPy and poly(Py co Py) derived polymers can be used as a new platform to develop new hybrid nanocomposites with enhanced properties for electrochemical applications.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the hybridization of the polymers on the surface of ZrO2 is an efficient strategy to improve their thermal, conductance and electrochemical properties.
the hybridization with ZrO2 enhances the thermal, conductive, and electrochemical properties of the resulting nanocomposite materials.
the nanocomposites are suitable for electrochemical applications.
